name: Add Lead
description: Create a new lead in Pipedrive. [See the documentation](https://developers.pipedrive.com/docs/api/v1/Leads#addLead)

configurable_props.name: personId
configurable_props.label: Person ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of a person which this lead will be linked to. If the person does not exist yet, it needs to be created first. This property is required unless organization_id is specified.

configurable_props.name: organizationId
configurable_props.label: Organization ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of an organization which this lead will be linked to. If the organization does not exist yet, it needs to be created first. This property is required unless person_id is specified.

configurable_props.name: ownerId
configurable_props.label: User ID
configurable_props.description: The ID of the user which will be the owner of the created lead. If not provided, the user making the request will be used.

configurable_props.name: leadLabelIds
configurable_props.label: Lead Label IDs
configurable_props.description: The IDs of the lead labels to associate with the lead

configurable_props.name: value
configurable_props.label: Value
configurable_props.description: Potential value of the lead, e.g. `{ "amount": 200, "currency": "EUR" }`

configurable_props.name: expectedCloseDate
configurable_props.label: Expected Close Date
configurable_props.description: The date of when the deal which will be created from the lead is expected to be closed. In ISO 8601 format: YYYY-MM-DD.

configurable_props.name: visibleTo
configurable_props.label: Visible To
configurable_props.description: The visibility of the lead. If omitted, the visibility will be set to the default visibility setting of this item type for the authorized user. Read more about visibility groups [here](https://support.pipedrive.com/en/article/visibility-groups).

options.label: Essential / Advanced plan - Owner & followers, Professional / Enterprise plan - Owner only
Essential / Advanced plan - Entire company, Professional / Enterprise plan - Owner's visibility group
Professional / Enterprise plan - Owner's visibility group and sub-groups

configurable_props.name: wasSeen
configurable_props.label: Was Seen
configurable_props.description: A flag indicating whether the lead was seen by someone in the Pipedrive UI

configurable_props.name: note
configurable_props.label: Note
configurable_props.description: A note to add to the lead
